newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Canadian fund to acquire Ukraine bank shares.
newsitem.headline: Canadian fund to acquire Ukraine bank shares.

text.p: The Ukraine Enterprise Corporation (UEC), a private Canadian investment company, will acquire 35 percent of Ukraine's Electron Bank after signing a $3.5 million deal late on Thursday, the head of UEC said.
"Basically we're putting in equity of $3.5 million. We're trying to build the bank up as one of the leading banks of Ukraine," UEC Director Bohdan Onyschuk told Reuters.
Toronto-based UEC will deliver the money in three tranches and will eventually hire foreign bankers to work at the Lviv bank to bring operations to a Western standard, Onyschuk said.
"The banking system and banking in Ukraine are small and the sector is weak," he said.
Canada, which has a large Ukrainian diaspora, has formed strong links with Ukraine.
UEC is planning a $44 million public offering and will list shares on the Alberta Stock Exchange, Onyschuk added.
